title: Kenyan-Style Oven-Roasted Meat Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic Kenyan-inspired dish featuring roasted meat kebabs, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the rich flavors of Africa with the convenience of oven cooking.

ingredients.name: beef strips
ingredients.notes: preferably flank steak or skirt steak

ingredients.name: kenyan spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most African markets or online

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the kenyan spice blend, olive oil, garlic, and habanero pepper.
Add the chopped onion and beef strips to the bowl, tossing to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef, onion, and habanero pepper onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the kebabs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Brush the kebabs with additional olive oil during the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
